title: Workstation
description: The <keyword>Workstation</keyword> is a two-part block that serves as a docking station for the <keyword>Tempad</keyword> and a stationary <keyword>Timedoor terminal</keyword>. <positive>Right-click</positive> the docking pad with a <keyword>Tempad</keyword> to dock it, which unlocks the <keyword>cassette slot</keyword> for upgrade tapes and enables the <property>Portal Setup app</property> on the terminal screen.

Upgrade tapes are installed by right-clicking them into the cassette slot on the back of the Workstation while a Tempad is docked. Each upgrade permanently adds new functionality to that specific Tempad.

When a Tempad is docked and the terminal receives a Redstone signal, it opens a Timedoor to the selected destination. The Portal Setup app allows fine-tuning the Timedoor’s position and rotation up to 5 blocks in any direction, as well as toggling whether the portal is upright or flat on the ground. A constant Redstone signal keeps the Timedoor open indefinitely at a cost of 10 Chronons per second.
